content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is located at Plot no.2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur. This post serves an ICMR-funded project in the Department of Physiology, with Dr. Smita R. Sorte, Additional Professor, as the project's Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Project Technical Support-II (Accountant) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age must not exceed 28 years. Age, qualifications and other criteria will be considered as of the last date of applications. Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com.) from a recognized university or institution. Working knowledge of accounting, bookkeeping, financial documentation and computer applications, particularly Microsoft Excel and Word. One year of relevant experience in accounts or finance work in a government institution, academic institution, research project or recognized organization. Experience is counted only after acquiring the essential qualification. M.Com., MBA (Finance) or an equivalent higher qualification in accounts or finance. Experience in maintaining accounts of externally funded research projects, preferably for ICMR or another Government of India funding agency. Knowledge of Utilization Certificates, Statements of Expenditure, budget-head reconciliation, supporting vouchers, e-office, PFMS, GeM and institutional financial procedures. Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and Marathi. Relaxation applies as per Government of India/ICMR rules issued from time to time. Additional relaxation may be considered for candidates with adequate relevant project or accounts experience, as permissible under the applicable rules. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department or Organization are not eligible. See the official notification (PDF) for the complete eligibility conditions of this post.

content_sections.heading: Nature of Duties
content_sections.text: Maintain the project cash book, ledger, budget-head-wise expenditure records, vouchers, bills, advances, settlements and supporting financial documents. Prepare and compile Utilization Certificates, Statements of Expenditure, financial statements, budget estimates, expenditure summaries and fund-reconciliation statements. Scrutinize financial documents from participating sites and coordinate the correction, compilation and submission of site-wise records. Monitor sanctioned allocations, funds received, expenditure, committed liabilities, available balances and re-appropriation or adjustment under approved budget heads. Assist the Principal Investigator in correspondence and coordination with ICMR, the AIIMS Nagpur Accounts Section, Administration and participating centres. Maintain electronic and physical records of sanctions, approvals, procurement documents, salary records, participant payments, travel claims and audit documents. Facilitate audit, financial review, procurement, salary processing and timely submission of project reports. Perform data entry and other project-related administrative, financial or documentation work assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of posting: AIIMS Nagpur. Tenure: till 19 December 2026. It may be extended up to 19 March 2027, subject to continuation of the post by ICMR, satisfactory performance and approval of the Competent Authority. The position is temporary and carries no claim to regular appointment at AIIMS Nagpur or ICMR, or to continuation in any other project. Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession, Medical Claim, Staff Quarters and other facilities for regular ICMR staff are not admissible. Leave is as per project recruitment rules, and the recruited staff member will have to give an undertaking before joining. The appointee may be relieved with one month's prior notice. Failing to give it may make the appointee responsible for paying one month's salary. The Principal Investigator reserves the right to terminate the contract with one month's notice. If the project is stalled or postponed in unforeseen circumstances, the salary may be delayed or stopped for that period. If the project is not extended, the contract will be terminated without any notice. The tenure ends automatically once the project duration is complete.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Google Form enough, or is a hard copy also needed?
faq.answer: Both are required. Candidates must submit the Google Form and also send a hard copy with one set of self-attested photocopies to Room No. 118, Department of Physiology, AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q2. Is an M.Com. or MBA (Finance) compulsory?
faq.answer: No. B.Com. is the essential degree, while M.Com., MBA (Finance) or an equivalent higher qualification in accounts or finance is only desirable.

faq.question: Q3. Does experience gained before completing B.Com. count?
faq.answer: No. The one year of relevant experience must be gained after acquiring the essential qualification, and the certificate must clearly state the nature of work.

faq.question: Q4. Can a candidate with a current job apply?
faq.answer: Yes, unless the job is regular time scale service under a Government Department or Organization. Currently employed candidates must submit a No-Objection Certificate from their present employer.

faq.question: Q5. How soon must the selected candidate join?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be required to join within one week of the declaration of the result.

faq.question: Q6. Is the 12 November 2026 interview date final?
faq.answer: No, it is tentative and may change due to administrative reasons. The notice asks candidates to check the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment page before appearing.

faq.question: Q7. What happens if original certificates are not brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Failure to bring original certificates to the written test or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel expenses be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid. Candidates have to arrange their own transport and accommodation.

faq.question: Q9. Can this project post lead to a regular job?
faq.answer: No. Project terms, with or without breaks, confer no right to appointment, absorption or regularization in ICMR or the funding agency. Canvassing in any form will also lead to disqualification during selection.
